prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A futuristic, cinematic scene set against a deep space backdrop filled with countless stars. In the center, a glowing, electric-blue energy sphere with crackling lightning hovers above a sleek white pedestal, radiating dynamic light and energy. Two men stand on either side of the pedestal, engaged in an animated conversation. The man on the left has short brown hair, wears a black sweatshirt with a subtle white logo, and looks on with a mix of curiosity and anticipation. The man on the right has shoulder-length blond hair, a trimmed beard, and wears a light blue button-up shirt over a white t-shirt; he gestures expressively with one hand, as if explaining or emphasizing a point. A vivid green neon light partially illuminates the left side of the scene, casting a surreal glow and partially revealing the word "son" in the background. The overall color palette is cool and high-contrast, dominated by blues, greens, and blacks, with the energy sphere providing a dramatic focal point. The lighting is crisp and cinematic, with a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the subjects and the energy sphere, while the starry background remains slightly blurred. The composition is balanced and dynamic, evoking a sense of wonder, discovery, and high-tech intrigue.
